title: Architecture-relative uniqueness in the binary-form programme after the July 2026 counterexample families
question: Do the July 2026 counterexample families described by Gallagher and Gao arise inside the binary-form factorisation architecture classified by the Evidence Press releases, and if not, should the isolation statement be scoped explicitly as uniqueness within that architecture?
summary: Compare explicit higher-degree counterexample families with the binary-form slice coordinates and classification hypotheses. The possible outcomes are a substantive surviving obstruction, a scope clarification with additional citations, or closure of the proposed connection as shared geometric vocabulary only.
whyNow: The relevant Evidence Press release predates or closely follows several July 2026 counterexample reports that are not listed in its related work. The submitted issue identifies an inexpensive exact-computer-algebra comparison that could distinguish a genuine scope tension from an innocent difference in parameter spaces.
